title: Database OOM killed, no restart policy
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the db as the broken part, a memory‑limit OOM problem triggered by the new analytics endpoint in API 2.3.2.
root_cause: The deployment of API version 2.3.2 introduced a new /api/analytics/report endpoint that executed a memory-intensive query, causing the PostgreSQL container to exceed its 1024 MB memory limit and be terminated by the OOM killer (signal 9).
truth: A new analytics endpoint in api 2.3.2 ran a massive query that pushed PostgreSQL over its 1 GB memory limit, causing the kernel to OOM-kill it. The database container has no restart policy, so it stayed down.
